_comment: Copy to config.json (or point ARTEX_CONFIG at another path). This file only holds database and skill_dir; LLM and all other settings come from environment variables or in-app settings, not this file.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Priority: env var ARTEX_PG_DSN > database in this file. Pick one of two styles: (A) fill in the individual fields below; (B) set only database.dsn as a full connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Style (B): delete the database block above and use a full DSN instead. When dsn is non-empty, the individual fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: Skill root directory (one skill per subdirectory, each containing SKILL.md). Priority: env var ARTEX_SKILL_DIR > this field > default (skills/ next to the executable). Leave empty or delete this field to use the default. Relative paths are resolved against the current working directory.
